summary: Official Damoh district land-record custody and DILRMP cadastral-status evidence were found, but MP land-record endpoints timed out or failed DNS and the public NAKSHA viewer did not expose an anonymous Damoh parcel layer. No sample GeoJSON is retained; runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Hindi first-party discovery queries and actual result URLs are recorded in city-9681-damoh.json. The district site identifies MP Bhu-Abhilekh/Bhu-Naksha and local land-record officials; DILRMP provides Damoh cadastral digitization status but not open parcel geometry.
requestOutcomes: The MP land-record host timed out and the linked Bhu-Naksha hostname failed DNS. DILRMP pages and NAKSHA landing HTML loaded, but no anonymous Damoh schema, CRS, stable native parcel ID or geometry response was obtained. No login, credentials, private token, unsafe field request, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass or TLS disablement was used.
